address: 2.1-2.4 Kingly Court, Carnaby Street, Soho, London, W1B 5PW, United Kingdom
bio: The cooking of Kolkata and Chef-Owner Asma Khan’s Mughal ancestry inform the menu at this bright and breezy restaurant on the top floor of the perennially busy Kingly Court. Asma can be found chatting away with diners while the all-female kitchen team create authentic, vibrant dishes whose careful spicing enhances each central ingredient. The methi chicken is an excellent example of their talents, the meat moist and flavoursome, its sauce wonderfully rich and bringing out the best in the chicken....
